This textbook is a self-study resource for the theoretical component of
**Web Applications and Services** (ASW), Master's in Electrical and
Computer Engineering (MEEC), covering Web application architecture, best
development practices, the HTTP protocol, HTML and CSS, server-side and
client-side programming, database access, and REST Web Services, with
Java EE as the case study.


## Organisation {.unnumbered}

The textbook is organised into three thematic blocks:

1. **Web Foundations** — client-server architecture, HTML, CSS and the
   HTTP protocol
2. **Classic Java EE** — Servlets, the stateful model and session
   management
3. **Web Services** — security and filters, and REST Web Services,
   including consuming an API from JavaScript in the browser

The practical LABs (the same as ESIGELEC's, with a JavaScript "twist"
specific to this course) are described in Appendix B of the Portuguese
edition.

## How to Use This Textbook {.unnumbered}

Each chapter corresponds to one theoretical class of the course. Students
are advised to read a chapter before the corresponding class, and to use
this text as support for independent study, to review concepts and
clarify doubts. Reading does not replace attendance in class, nor
participation in the practical LABs.
